sloka: न च अपि अहम् अनुक्तो वै प्रब्रूयाम् आत्मनो गुणान् ।समर्थ्श्चाप्यहम् सेतुम् कर्तुम् वै वरुणालये ॥६-२२-५१॥।।
transliteration: na ca api aham anukto vai prabrūyām ātmano guṇān ।samarthścāpyaham setum kartum vai varuṇālaye ॥6-22-51॥।।

translations.english: "On the Mandara mountain Vishwakarma gave a boon to my mother. I am that Vishwakarma's own son, and I am like him at work by that cause. I have put in my memory all about the ocean. I am aware of the truth of the ocean. I could not speak of my qualities unless questioned. I can build a bridge over the abode of Varuna.Right away let the Vanara leaders get the material required for building the bridge (said Nala)."
